messages:
alex: quick async — what I did: pushed the routing-policy PR (refs  #412) that adds weighted fallback to the v2 gateway, ran unit tests, and smoke on staging. blockers: saw 503s on long-tail requests when weight > 0.8, need help validating cache behavior. today: investigate KV cache TTL and update canary config.

maria: saw the 503s too during load test. looks like connection spikes to backend when routing flips. added a short-term mitigation: reduced max upstream connections from 1000 -> 600 on staging gateway.

jamal: noted. can you paste the gateway logs around the 503? I want to check the envoy upstream reset pattern.

maria: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T08:12:33Z] envoy upstream reset: reason=connection termination, x-envoy-upstream-service-time=0
[2026-03-16T08:12:33Z] request id=abc123 route=api.v2.token latency=200ms status=503
```

sasha: quick thought — when weighted fallback is high we create many small concurrent requests to the fallback model which can blow past the per-host connection limits. maybe batching window needs to expand for fallbacks.

alex: good call. jamal / li can we try increasing batching window from 5ms -> 20ms for fallback paths in staging config? that might reduce concurrency bursts.

li: I can flip that on staging. also found a small bug: KV cache TTL defaulted to 0 for pinned routes when the header `x-routing-pin` is present. PR incoming.

jamal: ping on CR #415 (envoy config tweaks) — I left comments about `circuit_breakers` thresholds. quick approve would help test the batching change in e2e.

alex: tagged you @jamal in the PR, address comments and then i'll merge and run a canary. :+1:

deploy-bot: deploy request queued: canary/gateway-v2 weight=10% — triggered by alex — status: pending

maria: small FYI — I updated the rate-limiter policy to explicitly exclude health-check paths (`/healthz`) to avoid token accounting noise.

sasha: also added a short note in the dashboard: token-cost per route now shows pre/post fallback split. helps see when fallback is costing us.

li: deployed batching window change to staging, running synthetic load now. will report numbers in ~10m.

alex: blockers for me removed for now — will watch canary and look into KV TTL default. if anyone sees 503s spike after canary, @alex please @here and we'll rollback.

maria: ack. if canary looks good i'll coordinate increasing to 30% later today.

jamal: CR #415 approved and merged. heads-up: I bumped `max_retries` to 1 for the fallback policy to prevent retry storms.

alex: perfect. thanks everyone. any quick asks?

sasha: can someone ping infra to raise ephemeral connection limit for the gateway pod in dev1? hitting limits in longer tests.

li: pinged infra (cc @infra-team) — they replied they'll look.

alex: ok closing this async check-in. I'll post a short follow-up after the 30m canary. :rocket:
